narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>A statistical statement uses one number to sum up many values.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>The word about often shows that the values vary.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Your turn. A friend says, I sleep about eight hours a night. What data is behind it?
